reviews_captured_by_me.text:
I'll let these pictures speak for themselves.

These were taken a week after the install of new granite countertops in our laundry room. They are not wet from the saw.

Ric says he's seen this before, that it's glue the installers didn't remove during install. If it's been seen before why is this still an issue? Why did the installer leave my home with counters looking like this? Just. Wow.

In addition they slopped shiny silicon in the cracks of the backsplash on a matte granite.

I don't know how they're going to fix it or when. We're still waiting for any communication to tell us when and how they're going to fix this.

If it gets fixed I'll update the review to reflect such. Right now, of course I can't recommend them. Completely unacceptable.

Hmmmm lets see u work there so of course its amazing.....  But all joking aside its a smaller company so the staff has the ability to really get to kniw the clients and there needs.  We have an amazing new variety of granite and quartz and some new cabinet stiles to create an amazing new kitchen or bathroom. Not to mention the tile selection. We are the only shop in Chico that does it all under one roof without subbing out so you save time and money.

It has been both a pleasure and so easy to work with New Again! We bought their Display cabinets and counters from their old show room and then paid them to install the counters. They were easy communicate with, personable and not pretentious. They gave us a great deal and our kitchen looks amazing!  I can’t recommend their team enough!
